strings.t: Direktè Kilti Elèv

strings.text: Head of School
strings.t: Direktè Jeneral Lekòl la

strings.text: The Head of School’s hope:
strings.t: Espwa Direktè Jeneral Lekòl la:

strings.text: “Students being transformed and becoming disciples of Christ, being anchored in their faith so that they know what they believe and why they believe it.”
strings.t: “Pou elèv yo transfòme epi vin disip Kris, byen ankre nan lafwa yo pou yo konnen sa yo kwè ak poukisa yo kwè l.”

strings.text: Weekly prayer groups for moms and for dads, and ways for grandparents and boosters to pray for the school.
strings.t: Gwoup lapriyè chak semèn pou manman ak pou papa, ak fason pou granparan ak manm booster club (klib sipòtè) priye pou lekòl la.

strings.text: Moms in Prayer
strings.t: Moms in Prayer

strings.text: “Covenant Day School’s Moms in Prayer groups meet weekly during the school year.” Moms pray together for the school community.
strings.t: “Gwoup Moms in Prayer Covenant Day School yo reyini chak semèn pandan ane lekòl la.” Manman yo priye ansanm pou kominote lekòl la.

strings.text: Dads Prayer Gathering
strings.t: Dads Prayer Gathering

strings.text: “Every Friday, CDS dads gather at the tennis gazebo for a time of fellowship and prayer.”
strings.t: “Chak vandredi, papa CDS yo reyini nan gazebo tenis la pou yon moman fratènite ak lapriyè.”

strings.text: Grandparents Prayer Walk
strings.t: Mach Lapriyè Granparan yo

strings.text: The 2026–27 calendar lists a Grandparents Prayer Walk in August.
strings.t: Kalandriye 2026–27 la gen yon Mach Lapriyè Granparan nan mwa out.

strings.text: Booster Club prayer partners
strings.t: Patnè lapriyè Booster Club

strings.text: Booster Club members can sign up for a “Prayer partnership”: a coach and an athlete to pray for all year.
strings.t: Manm Booster Club yo ka enskri pou yon “Patenarya lapriyè”: yon antrenè ak yon atlèt pou yo priye pou yo pandan tout ane a.

strings.text: Questions the school’s public pages leave open, to bring to a tour or an interview.
strings.t: Kesyon paj piblik lekòl la kite san repons, pou w pote nan yon vizit oswa yon entèvyou.

strings.text: What day and time is chapel for each division, and can parents attend?
strings.t: Ki jou ak ki lè chapèl fèt pou chak divizyon, epi èske paran yo ka asiste?

strings.text: Is chapel attendance required?
strings.t: Èske prezans nan chapèl obligatwa?

strings.text: Must a student share the family’s faith, or answer faith questions, to be admitted?
strings.t: Èske yon elèv dwe pataje lafwa fanmi an, oswa reponn kesyon sou lafwa, pou yo admèt li?

strings.text: Do parents sign or affirm the school’s belief summary, or any family agreement?
strings.t: Èske paran yo siyen oswa afime rezime kwayans lekòl la, oswa nenpòt akò fanmi?

strings.text: Who is interviewed at each grade: parents only, or the student too?
strings.t: Kiyès yo fè entèvyou nan chak klas: paran yo sèlman, oswa elèv la tou?

strings.text: Which high school Bible course carries the half unit, and what does a student who joins in 10th–12th grade take?
strings.t: Ki kou Bib High School ki gen mwatye inite a, epi kisa yon elèv ki antre nan 10yèm–12yèm ane pran?

strings.text: Which Bible translation do classes use?
strings.t: Ki tradiksyon Bib klas yo itilize?

strings.text: Must every middle and high school student go to Windy Gap, and who leads it?
strings.t: Èske chak elèv Middle School ak High School dwe ale Windy Gap, epi kiyès ki dirije l?

strings.text: Is the 5th-grade spring trip to Fort Caswell or to Kanuga? The school’s pages name both.
strings.t: Èske vwayaj prentan 5yèm ane a se nan Fort Caswell oswa nan Kanuga? Paj lekòl la nonmen toude.

strings.text: Are any mission trips planned for 2026–27, and for which grades?
strings.t: Èske gen vwayaj misyonè ki planifye pou 2026–27, epi pou ki klas?

strings.text: Do high school students serve as student chaplains?
strings.t: Èske elèv High School yo sèvi kòm chaplen elèv?

strings.text: When and where does Moms in Prayer meet?
strings.t: Ki lè ak ki kote Moms in Prayer reyini?

strings.text: November 27, 2026
strings.t: 27 novanm 2026

strings.text: Hickory Grove Christian School is “a ministry of Hickory Grove Baptist Church”. The church started it in 1995. Students take Bible as a core class every year, and the church’s pastors teach in chapel.
strings.t: Hickory Grove Christian School se “yon ministè Hickory Grove Baptist Church”. Legliz la te kòmanse l nan 1995. Elèv yo pran Bib kòm yon kou prensipal chak ane, epi pastè legliz la anseye nan chapèl.

strings.text: The school says: “Christian faith is the basis for everything we do at Hickory Grove Christian School.”
strings.t: Lekòl la di: “Lafwa kretyen se baz tout sa nou fè nan Hickory Grove Christian School.”

strings.text: chapels a year
strings.t: chapèl chak ane

strings.text: eight split mornings and two all-school chapels on the 2026–27 calendar
strings.t: uit maten kote chapèl la fèt an de pati, ak de chapèl pou tout lekòl la, sou kalandriye 2026–27 la

strings.text: years of Bible as a core class
strings.t: ane Bib kòm kou prensipal

strings.text: “from kindergarten through 12th grade”
strings.t: “depi kindergarten rive nan 12yèm ane”

strings.text: Bible credits to graduate
strings.t: kredi Bib pou gradye

strings.text: one Bible course each year of high school, of 27 credits in all
strings.t: yon kou Bib pou chak ane nan High School, sou 27 kredi an tout

strings.text: Bible verses memorized
strings.t: vèsè Bib aprann pa kè

strings.text: by the end of elementary school, about one a week
strings.t: rive nan fen Elementary School, anviwon youn chak semèn

strings.text: Chapel meets ten times a year, mostly on Thursday mornings. Elementary students worship first, then middle and high school. Pastors from Hickory Grove Baptist Church teach, and students help lead the music.
strings.t: Chapèl reyini dis fwa pa ane, sitou jedi maten. Elèv Elementary School yo adore an premye, apre sa se tou Middle School ak High School. Pastè Hickory Grove Baptist Church anseye, epi elèv yo ede dirije mizik la.

strings.text: Elementary chapel
strings.t: Chapèl Elementary School

strings.text: At 8:00 AM on chapel mornings. The 2026–27 series “follows men and women of the Bible who took a stand for God.”
strings.t: A 8:00 AM nan maten chapèl yo. Seri 2026–27 la “swiv gason ak fanm nan Bib la ki te kanpe fèm pou Bondye”.

strings.text: Speakers in fall 2026 included the church’s Family Discipleship Pastors.
strings.t: Pami oratè otòn 2026 yo te gen Family Discipleship Pastors (pastè fòmasyon disip pou fanmi) legliz la.

strings.text: Middle and high school chapel
strings.t: Chapèl Middle School ak High School

strings.text: At 9:30 AM, in the sanctuary. The 2026–27 theme is “Here I Stand.” Middle schoolers take notes on chapel sheets, and high schoolers write in a Here I Stand journal.
strings.t: A 9:30 AM, nan sanktyè legliz la. Tèm 2026–27 la se “Here I Stand” (Men kote m kanpe). Elèv Middle School yo pran nòt sou fèy chapèl, epi elèv High School yo ekri nan yon jounal Here I Stand.

strings.text: Speakers in fall 2026 included the church’s Student Discipleship Pastors. Students in grades 6–12 wear Honor Dress to chapel.
strings.t: Pami oratè otòn 2026 yo te gen Student Discipleship Pastors (pastè fòmasyon disip pou elèv) legliz la. Elèv klas 6–12 yo mete Honor Dress (rad seremoni) pou ale nan chapèl.

strings.text: A Thanksgiving Chapel and a Christmas Chapel bring the whole school together. Performing arts students lead the Christmas Chapel.
strings.t: Yon chapèl Thanksgiving (Jou Aksyon de Gras) ak yon chapèl Nwèl rasanble tout lekòl la. Se elèv atizay sèn yo ki dirije chapèl Nwèl la.

strings.text: Seniors also have a Senior Recognition Chapel in April.
strings.t: Elèv dènye ane yo gen tou yon Senior Recognition Chapel (chapèl pou onore elèv dènye ane yo) nan mwa avril.

strings.text: High school devotions
strings.t: Devosyon High School

strings.text: Every Wednesday, high schoolers hear a devotion on one of “thirty-four witnesses who stood firm for Christ across twenty centuries.” A teacher or pastor tells each story.
strings.t: Chak mèkredi, elèv High School yo tande yon devosyon sou youn nan “trannkat temwen ki te kanpe fèm pou Kris la pandan ven syèk”. Yon pwofesè oswa yon pastè rakonte chak istwa.

strings.text: Middle school devotions
strings.t: Devosyon Middle School

strings.text: Teachers lead a devotion every morning. Before school, the Quiet Time Cafe is open for devotions and journaling, from 7:00 to 7:15 a.m.
strings.t: Pwofesè yo dirije yon devosyon chak maten. Anvan lekòl, Quiet Time Cafe la ouvè pou devosyon ak pou ekri nan jounal, soti 7:00 rive 7:15 a.m.

strings.text: Chapel Band
strings.t: Chapel Band

strings.text: High school students “audition, rehearse and help our worship pastors lead student-led chapel.”
strings.t: Elèv High School yo “pase odisyon, fè repetisyon epi ede pastè adorasyon nou yo dirije chapèl kote se elèv yo ki alatèt”.

strings.text: Praise Team
strings.t: Praise Team

strings.text: A middle school course “designed for students who desire to use their musical talents to lead others in worship.”
strings.t: Yon kou Middle School “ki fèt pou elèv ki vle sèvi ak talan mizikal yo pou dirije lòt moun nan adorasyon”.

strings.text: Families can watch or visit.
strings.t: Fanmi yo ka gade oswa vin vizite.

strings.text: “Every chapel is streamed live and saved to our archive.” Visitors 18 and older can register ahead.
strings.t: “Chak chapèl pase an dirèk sou entènèt epi yo sove l nan achiv nou.” Vizitè ki gen 18 an oswa plis ka enskri davans.

strings.text: Chapel dates and times follow the school’s 2026–27 calendar and its chapel sign-up form.
strings.t: Dat ak lè chapèl yo suiv kalandriye 2026–27 lekòl la ak fòm enskripsyon chapèl li a.

strings.text: Bible is a required core class every year. Here is what each grade studies, and the four Bible credits a high school student needs to graduate.
strings.t: Bib se yon kou prensipal obligatwa chak ane. Men sa chak klas etidye, ak kat kredi Bib yon elèv High School bezwen pou gradye.

strings.text: “Bible classes are mandatory at the elementary, middle, and high school levels”.
strings.t: “Kou Bib yo obligatwa nan Elementary School, Middle School ak High School”.

strings.text: Elementary students “memorize about one Bible verse each week.”
strings.t: Elèv Elementary School yo “aprann anviwon yon vèsè Bib pa kè chak semèn”.

strings.text: Elementary School
strings.t: Elementary School

strings.text: Bible every day
strings.t: Bib chak jou

strings.text: Kindergarten–Grade 5
strings.t: Kindergarten–Klas 5

strings.text: Building on the Rock, “a biblical worldview and Bible survey curriculum.” “Each day begins with Scripture, a teacher devotional and prayer”.
strings.t: Building on the Rock, “yon pwogram sou vizyon biblik sou lemonn ak yon apèsi sou Bib la”. “Chak jou kòmanse ak Ekriti yo, yon devosyon pwofesè a fè ak lapriyè”.

strings.text: Kingdom Builders
strings.t: Kingdom Builders

strings.text: A special class with “Biblically based lessons about things like communication, conflict resolution, problem solving, and sportsmanship”.
strings.t: Yon kou espesyal ak “leson ki baze sou Bib la sou bagay tankou kominikasyon, rezoud konfli, rezoud pwoblèm ak bon lespri nan espò”.

strings.text: a Bible class every year
strings.t: yon kou Bib chak ane

strings.text: Building on the Rock
strings.t: Building on the Rock

strings.text: The Christian worldview, from Summit Ministries.
strings.t: Vizyon kretyen sou lemonn, ki soti nan Summit Ministries.

strings.text: Walking in Truth
strings.t: Walking in Truth

strings.text: Compares the key beliefs of Christianity with Islam, naturalism and new spirituality. From Summit Ministries.
strings.t: Li konpare kwayans prensipal Krisyanis la ak Islam, naturalis ak nouvo espiritualite. Li soti nan Summit Ministries.

strings.text: Light Bearers
strings.t: Light Bearers

strings.text: Helps students “understand how they can live out their Christian worldview in a post-Christian culture.” From Summit Ministries.
strings.t: Li ede elèv yo “konprann kijan yo ka viv vizyon kretyen yo sou lemonn nan yon kilti pòs-kretyen”. Li soti nan Summit Ministries.

strings.text: Faith and leadership electives
strings.t: Kou opsyonèl sou lafwa ak lidèchip

strings.text: Courses include Becoming a Young Man of God and Becoming a Young Woman of God (grades 7–8), Student on Mission, and Christian Leadership for selected 8th graders.
strings.t: Pami kou yo gen Becoming a Young Man of God ak Becoming a Young Woman of God (klas 7–8), Student on Mission, ak Christian Leadership pou kèk elèv 8yèm ane yo chwazi.

strings.text: 4 Bible credits to graduate
strings.t: 4 kredi Bib pou gradye

strings.text: College prep or honors. Students “survey the entire Bible through broad themes”.
strings.t: Nivo preparasyon inivèsite oswa honors. Elèv yo “fè yon apèsi sou tout Bib la atravè gwo tèm”.

strings.text: College prep or honors. The books of the New Testament, its world and the life of Christ.
strings.t: Nivo preparasyon inivèsite oswa honors. Liv Nouvo Testaman yo, monn epòk la ak lavi Kris la.

strings.text: Christian Apologetics
strings.t: Christian Apologetics

strings.text: College prep or honors. Students learn “the logical, philosophical, historical, and scientific evidences for the Christian faith.” Honors Introduction to Philosophy is the other choice.
strings.t: Nivo preparasyon inivèsite oswa honors. Elèv yo aprann “prèv lojik, filozofik, istorik ak syantifik pou lafwa kretyen an”. Lòt chwa a se Honors Introduction to Philosophy.

strings.text: Systematic Theology
strings.t: Systematic Theology

strings.text: College prep or honors. Students “solidify their understanding of doctrines essential to the orthodox Christian faith.” Honors Introduction to Ethics is the other choice.
strings.t: Nivo preparasyon inivèsite oswa honors. Elèv yo “ranfòse konpreyansyon yo sou doktrin ki esansyèl pou lafwa kretyen òtodòks la”. Lòt chwa a se Honors Introduction to Ethics.

strings.text: Introduction to Bible
strings.t: Introduction to Bible

strings.text: A course “recommended for students who have never attended a Christian school or are new to HGCS.” Enrollment is by the school’s recommendation.
strings.t: Yon kou “rekòmande pou elèv ki pa janm ale nan yon lekòl kretyen oswa ki fèk antre nan HGCS”. Se sou rekòmandasyon lekòl la yon elèv enskri ladan l.

strings.text: Honors and college credit.
strings.t: Honors ak kredi inivèsite.

strings.text: Five honors Bible courses are dual enrollment courses through Judson College, “the undergraduate college program of Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary (SEBTS).”
strings.t: Senk kou Bib honors se kou dual enrollment (doub enskripsyon) ak Judson College, “pwogram inivèsite premye sik Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary (SEBTS)”.

strings.text: Middle school Spanish Immersion students take Bible in Spanish.
strings.t: Elèv Spanish Immersion (imèsyon an panyòl) nan Middle School yo pran Bib an panyòl.

strings.text: Where students talk about faith in smaller groups: monthly middle school groups and teacher-led high school groups.
strings.t: Kote elèv yo pale sou lafwa nan pi piti gwoup: gwoup chak mwa nan Middle School ak gwoup pwofesè dirije nan High School.

strings.text: Grove Groups
strings.t: Grove Groups

strings.text: “On the first Thursday of each month,” students meet by grade level to learn from “the lives of martyrs, missionaries, and mentors”, then split into small discipleship groups.
strings.t: “Chak premye jedi nan mwa a”, elèv yo reyini pa nivo klas pou aprann nan “lavi mati, misyonè ak mantò yo”, apre sa yo separe an ti gwoup fòmasyon disip.

strings.text: Discipleship groups (D-groups)
strings.t: Gwoup fòmasyon disip (D-groups)

strings.text: “Every high school student is placed in a small discipleship group led by a teacher.” Groups meet in the midday Club Flex time on most Thursdays.
strings.t: “Yo mete chak elèv High School nan yon ti gwoup fòmasyon disip yon pwofesè dirije.” Gwoup yo reyini pandan lè Club Flex nan mitan jounen an, pifò jedi.

strings.text: A student pastor on campus
strings.t: Yon pastè pou elèv sou kanpis la

strings.text: The church’s “student discipleship pastor is on campus and available for one-on-one conversations with students.”
strings.t: “Pastè fòmasyon disip pou elèv” legliz la “sou kanpis la epi li disponib pou konvèsasyon youn-a-youn ak elèv yo”.

strings.text: Christian Leadership
strings.t: Christian Leadership

strings.text: A course for selected 8th graders, who “will be expected to commit to serving as campus leaders throughout the entire school year.”
strings.t: Yon kou pou kèk elèv 8yèm ane yo chwazi, ki “ap gen pou yo angaje yo pou sèvi kòm lidè sou kanpis la pandan tout ane lekòl la”.

strings.text: Teams too.
strings.t: Ekip espò yo tou.

strings.text: One goal of the athletics program is to “Disciple Athletes”: “We will strive to have great discipleship on our teams.”
strings.t: Youn nan objektif pwogram espò a se “Fè atlèt yo vin disip”: “N ap fè efò pou gen bon fòmasyon disip nan ekip nou yo.”

strings.text: The school’s mission and vision, the beliefs it lists, and the outcomes it hopes for in every student, in the school’s own words.
strings.t: Misyon ak vizyon lekòl la, kwayans li bay sou lis, ak rezilta li espere wè nan chak elèv, nan pwòp mo lekòl la.

strings.text: “Hickory Grove Christian School disciples students through a biblical worldview, forming them in academics, athletics, and arts to be committed to God, connected to the mission, and wise in Christ, that they may know Him and make Him known.”
strings.t: “Hickory Grove Christian School fòme elèv yo kòm disip atravè yon vizyon biblik sou lemonn; li fòme yo nan etid akademik, espò ak atizay pou yo angaje ak Bondye, konekte ak misyon an, epi saj nan Kris la, pou yo ka konnen L epi fè lòt moun konnen L.”

strings.text: All truth is God's truth, and that every subject should be taught through a biblical worldview.
strings.t: Tout verite se verite Bondye, epi yo dwe anseye chak matyè atravè yon vizyon biblik sou lemonn.

strings.text: Christian education is a shared effort among the school, the home, Hickory Grove Baptist Church, and the broader body of Christ.
strings.t: Edikasyon kretyen se yon efò ansanm ant lekòl la, lakay, Hickory Grove Baptist Church ak tout kò Kris la an jeneral.

strings.text: Christian education must have an eternal perspective, focused on the salvation and discipleship of the next generation.
strings.t: Edikasyon kretyen dwe gen yon pèspektiv etènèl, ki konsantre sou delivrans ak fòmasyon disip pwochen jenerasyon an.

strings.text: Success at HGCS is measured not only by students' leadership, excellence, and integrity, but most of all by a lifelong commitment to Jesus Christ.
strings.t: Nan HGCS, yo pa mezire siksè sèlman pa lidèchip, ekselans ak entegrite elèv yo, men sitou pa yon angajman pou tout lavi ak Jezikri.

strings.text: A rigorous environment across academics, athletics, and the arts fully prepares students for the challenges ahead of them.
strings.t: Yon anviwònman egzijan nan etid akademik, espò ak atizay prepare elèv yo nèt pou defi ki devan yo.

strings.text: Students learn in different ways, so our teachers use a variety of instructional strategies to support each learner.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann nan diferan fason, kidonk pwofesè nou yo itilize plizyè estrateji ansèyman pou sipòte chak elèv.

strings.text: Each student is created in the image of God, with unique spiritual, academic, physical, mental, and emotional needs.
strings.t: Chak elèv kreye dapre imaj Bondye, ak pwòp bezwen espirityèl, akademik, fizik, mantal ak emosyonèl pa li.

strings.text: Committed to God
strings.t: Angaje ak Bondye

strings.text: Devoted to the Lord with rightly ordered loves
strings.t: Konsakre bay Senyè a, ak afeksyon ki byen an lòd

strings.text: Connected to the Mission
strings.t: Konekte ak Misyon an

strings.text: Joined to the body of Christ in shared mission
strings.t: Mare ak kò Kris la nan yon misyon ansanm

strings.text: Wise in Christ
strings.t: Saj nan Kris la

strings.text: Discerning between the biblical wisdom of God and the wisdom of the world
strings.t: Konn fè diferans ant sajès biblik Bondye ak sajès lemonn

strings.text: A ministry of Hickory Grove Baptist Church.
strings.t: Yon ministè Hickory Grove Baptist Church.

strings.text: Its vision: “To know Christ and to make Him known through Christian education.”
strings.t: Vizyon li: “Konnen Kris la epi fè lòt moun konnen L atravè edikasyon kretyen.”

strings.text: The school verse is Matthew 6:33. The school holds dual accreditation through Cognia and the Association of Christian Schools International (ACSI).
strings.t: Vèsè lekòl la se Matthew 6:33. Lekòl la gen doub akreditasyon atravè Cognia ak Association of Christian Schools International (ACSI).

strings.text: Every grade’s checklist lists a “Personal Recommendation form” from the family’s pastor. For middle and high school it is “from student/family’s pastor”.
strings.t: Lis verifikasyon chak klas mande yon “Personal Recommendation form” (fòm rekòmandasyon pèsonèl) pastè fanmi an ranpli. Pou Middle School ak High School, li “soti nan pastè elèv la/fanmi an”.

strings.text: “Family Interview is an opportunity to share the Mission, Vision, and Statement of Faith, and to assess whether HGCS is the right fit for your family”.
strings.t: “Entèvyou ak Fanmi an se yon okazyon pou pataje Misyon an, Vizyon an ak Deklarasyon Lafwa a, epi pou evalye si HGCS bon pou fanmi w”.

strings.text: Student questionnaire
strings.t: Kesyonè elèv la

strings.text: Applicants in grades 4–12 fill in a Student Questionnaire. Its questions are not on the public site.
strings.t: Kandida pou klas 4–12 ranpli yon Student Questionnaire (kesyonè elèv). Kesyon li yo pa sou sit piblik la.

strings.text: Church members apply first
strings.t: Manm legliz la aplike an premye

strings.text: Applications opened on November 2, 2026, for church members, Early Education Center students and siblings, and on November 16 for all new families.
strings.t: Aplikasyon yo te ouvri 2 novanm 2026 pou manm legliz la, elèv Early Education Center ak frè ak sè yo, epi 16 novanm pou tout nouvo fanmi.

strings.text: The public pages do not say whether a parent must be a Christian or belong to a church. The Mallard Creek preschool’s interest form does ask about the family’s church and the parents’ faith.
strings.t: Paj piblik yo pa di si yon paran dwe kretyen oswa manm yon legliz. Fòm enterè preschool Mallard Creek la poze kesyon sou legliz fanmi an ak lafwa paran yo.

strings.text: Agreeing to a statement of faith
strings.t: Dakò ak yon deklarasyon lafwa

strings.text: The public pages do not say whether families sign one.
strings.t: Paj piblik yo pa di si fanmi yo siyen youn.

strings.text: Required every year.
strings.t: Obligatwa chak ane.

strings.text: Honor Code
strings.t: Honor Code

strings.text: “Every high school student signs our Student Honor Code, a covenant organized around our three Expected Student Outcomes.”
strings.t: “Chak elèv High School siyen Student Honor Code nou an, yon alyans ki òganize sou twa Rezilta Nou Atann pou Elèv yo.”

strings.text: Dress for chapel
strings.t: Rad pou chapèl

strings.text: “Honor Dress is required for all chapel programs in 6th-12th grades and at certain special events.”
strings.t: “Honor Dress obligatwa pou tout pwogram chapèl nan klas 6yèm rive 12yèm ane ak nan kèk aktivite espesyal.”

strings.text: The job posting asks for a “Committed Christian in agreement with the school’s Statement of Faith” who is “Active in a local bible-believing church.”
strings.t: Anons travay la mande yon “Kretyen angaje ki dakò ak Deklarasyon Lafwa lekòl la” ki “aktif nan yon legliz lokal ki kwè nan Bib la”.

strings.text: The school keeps its Parent-Student Handbook and its online application behind a family login.
strings.t: Lekòl la kenbe Parent-Student Handbook (manyèl paran ak elèv) li a ak aplikasyon sou entènèt li a dèyè yon koneksyon pou fanmi.

strings.text: Seniors go on a mission trip to the Dominican Republic each year, and the whole school gives to a cause each quarter.
strings.t: Elèv dènye ane yo fè yon vwayaj misyonè nan Repiblik Dominikèn chak ane, epi tout lekòl la bay pou yon kòz chak trimès.

strings.text: Senior Mission Trip
strings.t: Vwayaj misyonè elèv dènye ane yo

strings.text: “Our seniors serve together annually on a mission trip to the Dominican Republic.” The 2026–27 trip is in January 2027.
strings.t: “Elèv dènye ane nou yo sèvi ansanm chak ane nan yon vwayaj misyonè nan Repiblik Dominikèn.” Vwayaj 2026–27 la fèt nan mwa janvye 2027.

strings.text: High School Mission Week
strings.t: Semèn Misyon High School

strings.text: “While the seniors are away, the rest of the high school serves the local community through Mission Week.”
strings.t: “Pandan elèv dènye ane yo pa la, rès High School la sèvi kominote lokal la atravè Mission Week (Semèn Misyon).”

strings.text: Quarterly missions collection
strings.t: Kolèk pou misyon chak trimès

strings.text: “Each quarter, our school family gives to support a local ministry or cause.” Causes named include XChange, an addiction ministry of the church; Operation Christmas Child; and a Baby Bottle Drive “supporting the sanctity of human life”.
strings.t: “Chak trimès, fanmi lekòl nou an bay pou sipòte yon ministè oswa yon kòz lokal.” Pami kòz yo nonmen gen XChange, yon ministè legliz la pou moun ki gen depandans; Operation Christmas Child; ak yon Baby Bottle Drive (kolèk nan bibon) “pou sipòte sakre lavi moun”.

strings.text: HGBC Food Pantry
strings.t: HGBC Food Pantry

strings.text: Spanish Immersion students “serve as interpreters each week as our pastors share the Gospel with our community.” The high school aquaponics lab “grows food for the HG Food Pantry.”
strings.t: Elèv Spanish Immersion yo “sèvi kòm entèprèt chak semèn pandan pastè nou yo ap pataje Levanjil la ak kominote nou an”. Laboratwa akwaponik High School la “kiltive manje pou HG Food Pantry”.

strings.text: Student on Mission
strings.t: Student on Mission

strings.text: A middle school course that “studies what God is doing around the world and how students can serve Charlotte.”
strings.t: Yon kou Middle School ki “etidye sa Bondye ap fè toupatou sou latè ak kijan elèv yo ka sèvi Charlotte”.

strings.text: Global Missions & Language Certificate
strings.t: Global Missions & Language Certificate

strings.text: Students earn it with three units of a foreign language, honors Bible courses, “at least one international mission trip” and a missions practicum or internship.
strings.t: Elèv yo jwenn li ak twa inite nan yon lang etranjè, kou Bib honors, “omwen yon vwayaj misyonè entènasyonal” ak yon staj pratik oswa yon entènship nan misyon.

strings.text: The course catalog adds one more requirement: “Be an active church member of like-minded faith, verified through a positive letter of recommendation by a pastor, preferably the student’s Youth Pastor.”
strings.t: Katalòg kou yo ajoute yon lòt egzijans: “Se pou w yon manm aktif nan yon legliz ki gen menm lafwa, sa ki verifye pa yon lèt rekòmandasyon pozitif yon pastè ekri, depreferans Pastè Jèn elèv la.”

strings.text: Host families
strings.t: Fanmi akèy

strings.text: Church families and school families can host an international student. The school calls it “missions in reverse”.
strings.t: Fanmi legliz la ak fanmi lekòl la ka resevwa yon elèv entènasyonal lakay yo. Lekòl la rele sa “misyon nan sans envès”.

strings.text: Outreach beyond Charlotte.
strings.t: Misyon pi lwen pase Charlotte.

strings.text: The school names “international outreach efforts in the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Haiti, and Kenya.”
strings.t: Lekòl la nonmen “efò misyon entènasyonal nan Repiblik Dominikèn, Ekwatè, Ayiti ak Kenya”.

strings.text: The school’s pages give no service-hour requirement.
strings.t: Paj lekòl la pa bay okenn egzijans èdtan sèvis.

strings.text: Pastors from Hickory Grove Baptist Church teach in chapel and lead the parent sessions. The school lists no chaplain of its own.
strings.t: Pastè Hickory Grove Baptist Church anseye nan chapèl epi yo dirije sesyon pou paran yo. Lekòl la pa mansyone okenn chaplen pa li.

strings.text: Senior Pastor, Hickory Grove Baptist Church; Advisory Board member
strings.t: Pastè Prensipal, Hickory Grove Baptist Church; manm Konsèy Konsiltatif

strings.text: Student Discipleship Pastor, Hickory Grove Baptist Church
strings.t: Pastè Fòmasyon Disip pou Elèv, Hickory Grove Baptist Church

strings.text: Family Discipleship Pastor, Hickory Grove Baptist Church
strings.t: Pastè Fòmasyon Disip pou Fanmi, Hickory Grove Baptist Church

strings.text: Bible Department Head, High School
strings.t: Chèf Depatman Bib, High School

strings.text: Middle School Bible, PE
strings.t: Bib Middle School, Edikasyon Fizik (PE)

strings.text: Teachers and leaders share the Wednesday devotions.
strings.t: Pwofesè ak dirijan yo fè devosyon mèkredi yo chak a tou pa yo.

strings.text: Speakers in fall 2026 included the head of school and the high school principal.
strings.t: Pami oratè otòn 2026 yo te gen direktè jeneral lekòl la ak direktè High School la.

strings.text: A parent session on chapel mornings, take-home recaps of every chapel and devotion, and a monthly prayer group.
strings.t: Yon sesyon pou paran nan maten chapèl yo, rezime pou lakay sou chak chapèl ak chak devosyon, ak yon gwoup lapriyè chak mwa.

strings.text: Lions Connect
strings.t: Lions Connect

strings.text: “Lions Connect meets on chapel mornings, between Elementary Chapel and Middle and High School Chapel, so you can worship with your child and stay for both.” Church pastors lead it, at 9:00 AM.
strings.t: “Lions Connect reyini nan maten chapèl yo, ant Chapèl Elementary School ak Chapèl Middle School ak High School, pou w ka adore ak pitit ou epi rete pou toude.” Se pastè legliz la ki dirije l, a 9:00 AM.

strings.text: Fall 2026 topics were “Because I Told You So” and “Hard Providences.”
strings.t: Sijè otòn 2026 yo se te “Because I Told You So” (Paske se mwen ki di w sa) ak “Hard Providences” (Pwovidans ki difisil).

strings.text: Chapel at Home
strings.t: Chapel at Home

strings.text: After every chapel, families get a recap with the message, its Scripture and “a few questions to talk through with your child.” There is an elementary version and a middle and high school version.
strings.t: Apre chak chapèl, fanmi yo resevwa yon rezime ak mesaj la, pasaj Ekriti li a ak “kèk kesyon pou diskite ak pitit ou”. Gen yon vèsyon pou Elementary School ak yon vèsyon pou Middle School ak High School.

strings.text: Devotion recaps
strings.t: Rezime devosyon yo

strings.text: A one-page recap of each high school Wednesday devotion, “so you can ask your student about it at dinner or in the car.”
strings.t: Yon rezime yon paj sou chak devosyon mèkredi High School la, “pou w ka poze pitit ou kesyon sou li pandan manje aswè oswa nan machin nan”.

strings.text: Lions in Prayer
strings.t: Lions in Prayer

strings.text: “Parents gather once a month to pray for our students, staff and school.” Meetings are at 8:00 AM on the first Monday of the month.
strings.t: “Paran yo reyini yon fwa pa mwa pou priye pou elèv nou yo, anplwaye nou yo ak lekòl nou an.” Reyinyon yo fèt a 8:00 AM premye lendi nan mwa a.

strings.text: The Parent Teacher Fellowship.
strings.t: Parent Teacher Fellowship (asosyasyon paran ak pwofesè) la.

strings.text: “We call ourselves a fellowship because we are believers united in furthering Kingdom Education.”
strings.t: “Nou rele tèt nou yon fellowship (kominyon) paske nou se kwayan ki ini pou fè Edikasyon Wayòm nan avanse.”

strings.text: Contact: Cynthia Sampson, cynthiasampson@hgchristian.org.
strings.t: Kontak: Cynthia Sampson, cynthiasampson@hgchristian.org.

strings.text: Twelve questions to take on the tour. Each covers something the school’s public pages leave unanswered or say two ways.
strings.t: Douz kesyon pou w pote nan vizit la. Chak kesyon se sou yon bagay paj piblik lekòl la pa reponn oswa di de fason diferan.

strings.text: What does the pastor’s recommendation form ask? What if our family does not have a pastor?
strings.t: Kisa fòm rekòmandasyon pastè a mande? E si fanmi nou pa gen yon pastè?

strings.text: May we read the Statement of Faith shared in the family interview? Do families sign it?
strings.t: Èske nou ka li Deklarasyon Lafwa yo pataje nan entèvyou ak fanmi an? Èske fanmi yo siyen l?

strings.text: How often does chapel meet? One page says once a month, and the 2026–27 calendar has two in March.
strings.t: Konbyen fwa chapèl reyini? Yon paj di yon fwa pa mwa, epi kalandriye 2026–27 la gen de nan mwa mas.

strings.text: How often do high school discipleship groups meet? One page says several times a month, and another says most Thursdays.
strings.t: Konbyen fwa gwoup fòmasyon disip High School yo reyini? Yon paj di plizyè fwa pa mwa, yon lòt di pifò jedi.

strings.text: Does every senior go on the Dominican Republic mission trip, and is it part of tuition?
strings.t: Èske tout elèv dènye ane yo ale nan vwayaj misyonè Repiblik Dominikèn nan, epi èske li fè pati frè eskolè a?

strings.text: How many Bible credits does a student who joins in 10th, 11th or 12th grade need?
strings.t: Konbyen kredi Bib yon elèv ki antre nan 10yèm, 11yèm oswa 12yèm ane bezwen?

strings.text: Are there any retreats, for any grade?
strings.t: Èske gen retrèt, pou nenpòt klas?

strings.text: Are service hours required?
strings.t: Èske èdtan sèvis obligatwa?

strings.text: Do elementary and middle school students sign the Honor Code too?
strings.t: Èske elèv Elementary School ak Middle School siyen Honor Code la tou?

strings.text: May we read the Parent-Student Handbook before we enroll?
strings.t: Èske nou ka li Parent-Student Handbook la anvan nou enskri?
